script: Two soldiers parachuted into Prague with one job, to kill the most feared man in the Nazi regime. Reinhard Heydrich ran the machinery of the Holocaust, so feared that other Nazi officers called him the Butcher of Prague. In 1942, two Czechoslovak soldiers trained in Britain ambushed his open car on a sharp corner. Their machine gun jammed at the critical second. One soldier improvised, threw a grenade instead, and it tore through the car. Heydrich died of his wounds days later. Hitler's revenge was immediate, an entire village was burned to the ground and erased from maps. The soldiers who did it were never caught alive, holding out in a church until the end.

description:
Operation Anthropoid, 1942: two Czechoslovak soldiers ambushed Reinhard Heydrich, architect of the Holocaust. Their gun jammed. A thrown grenade killed him anyway -- and Hitler burned an entire village in revenge.
